author: Arjun
text: When an employee is inactive for 30 minutes, the portal shall end the employee's session.

author: Meera
text: The system shall retain audit log entries for 3 years.

author: Kabir
text: API requests shall time out after 30 seconds.

author: Sana
text: If an uploaded file is larger than 100 MB, then the system shall reject the upload.

author: Riya
text: Guests shall sign in before downloading any shared document.

author: Sana
text: Deleted documents shall be removed permanently after 7 days.

author: Arjun
text: The system shall allow at most one active session per user.

author: Kabir
text: Password reset emails shall be sent in a nightly batch.

author: Arjun
text: The system shall log every failed sign-in attempt.

author: Arjun
text: When a user signs in successfully, the system shall record the sign-in.

author: Meera
text: The system shall encrypt all stored user data with AES-256.

author: Riya
text: Users shall be able to export the data held about them in a machine-readable format.

author: Arjun
text: Passwords shall be hashed with bcrypt before they are stored.

author: Sana
text: Users shall be able to recover a deleted document for 30 days after deleting it.

author: Arjun
text: When an account is locked, the system shall email the account owner.

author: Arjun
text: Where multi-factor authentication is enabled, the system shall ask for the second factor after the password.

author: Kabir
text: The monthly usage report shall include the number of documents uploaded by each user.

author: Meera
text: When an audit log entry reaches the end of its retention period, the system shall archive it to cold storage before deleting it.

author: Kabir
text: If a password reset email bounces, then the system shall notify the workspace administrator.

author: Riya
text: The search page shall load fast.

author: Kabir
text: The portal shall support a reasonable number of concurrent users.

author: Sana
text: Uploads shall be processed in a timely fashion.

author: Riya
text: The document viewer shall be intuitive.

author: Kabir
text: Notifications shall be sent frequently enough to keep users informed.

author: Meera
text: The system shall keep old documents for an appropriate period.

author: Arjun
text: The system shall send an alert.

author: Riya
text: When a document is shared, the system shall send a notification.

author: Sana
text: If an upload fails, then the system shall retry the upload.

author: Sana
text: The system shall lock the document.

author: Meera
text: Workspace administrators shall approve the request.

author: Meera
text: Audit log entries shall be kept for 5 years.

author: Arjun
text: Every failed sign-in shall be written to the security log.

author: Sana
text: The system shall show the file size next to every document in a folder listing.

author: Sana
text: When a document is renamed, the system shall keep its version history.

author: Kabir
text: Workspace administrators shall be able to export the list of workspace members as a CSV file.

author: Riya
text: The portal shall display dates in the employee's local time zone.

author: Sana
text: While a document is being uploaded, the portal shall show the upload progress as a percentage.

author: Riya
text: Where the browser language is German, the portal shall display its menus in German.

author: Sana
text: The system shall let an employee add a description of up to 500 characters to each document.

author: Kabir
text: When a workspace is created, the system shall create an empty Shared folder in it.
